en.title: Maximum Occurrences for Each Prefix Length
en.description:
n strings all have length m. For each length 1..m, find how many times the most frequent prefix occurs; duplicate strings are counted as separate input records, and only the count is output, not the prefix.

The standard I/O and the solution were written independently by this site; ranges marked as this site's are not the original source constraints.
en.input: The first line contains n m, followed by n strings of equal length. The source has 2≤n≤500 and 1≤m≤2000; the source does not restrict the character set, and this site uses lowercase letters.
en.output: Output m maximum occurrence counts for prefix lengths 1..m in order.
en.explanation: Example 1: a and ab each occur 3 times, and aba occurs 2 times, so output 3 3 2. Example 2: the first letter a occurs 3 times, ab 2 times, and each full string once, so output 3 2 1. Example 3: the prefixes of both lengths occur 2 times, so output 2 2.
hints: Refine the prefix groups column by column: a new group is uniquely determined by the old prefix group number and the current character; count the members of each group and take the maximum.
